name: Hatakeyama Merussia
source: Stay-at-home mom who lives in the apartment. She has a family of three, her husband and daughter. Her husband is often not at home, he frequently works abroad or outside the town. Perhaps because she wanted a boy, she sees [url=/c11723]Shoutaro[/url] as if he was her cute son.
